label: App Marketplace
seo_description: Discover apps and blueprints that extend RunMyCampus: integrations, themes, and workflow packs.
headline: App marketplace.
subheadline: Extend your platform with approved apps, ready-made setups, and integrations—governed and school-safe.

segments.title: Ready-made setups
segments.body: Pre-built policy and workflow bundles for faster launch and best practices.

segments.title: Integrations
segments.body: LMS, payments, messaging, and data exchange with versioning and kill switches.

segments.title: Governed rollout
segments.body: Review pipeline, permission scopes, and sandbox so only safe extensions reach your tenant.

faqs.question: How are marketplace apps reviewed?
faqs.answer: Extensions go through a governed review path with permission scopes and operational safeguards before tenant rollout.

faqs.question: Can we build our own pack?
faqs.answer: Yes—use the developer platform and packaging flows documented for partners and internal builders.
